reading.text:
UNIT def:LevyStochCalc.Brownian.Multidim.MultidimBrownianMotion.naturalFiltration -- reading (locked before any Lean)

Paper notion: the filtration generated by the d-dimensional Brownian motion,
F^W_t = sigma(W^j_s : s <= t, j < d) (sec. 2: (F_t) is the usual augmentation of the filtration
generated by W, N and F_0; Example ex:brownian: "the filtration is generated by W and F_0").
Faithful Lean: the Filtration with F_t = sup over j and s <= t of comap of W^j_s (the JOINT
natural filtration of all coordinates), not the filtration of a single coordinate. Raw (not
augmented); augmentation and enlargement by N and F_0 are added elsewhere. Junk when W is not
measurable is harmless since the structure guarantees measurability.

Paper context (sec. 2, sec. 3, sec. 4, App. A). Standing basis: (Omega,F,(F_t),P) satisfying the usual
conditions, horizon T>0, d-dimensional Brownian motion W and an independent Poisson random
measure N on R_+ x E with intensity dt nu(de), nu sigma-finite on a countably generated (E,E);
(F_t) is the usual augmentation of the filtration generated by W, N and an independent initial
sigma-field F_0. Stochastic integrals int Z dW (Z in H^2_W: R^{m x d}-valued predictable,
E int_0^T |Z|_F^2 dt < oo) and int int U dNtilde (U in H^2_N) are the L^2 (Ito /
compensated-Poisson isometry) integrals; they are true L^2 martingales, cadlag, and are used in
identities holding a.s. for every t (sec. 3, "solution"). The paper never constructs these
integrals itself: it takes the standard construction (Applebaum sec. 4, He-Wang-Yan). So every
unit below is infrastructure: the paper's notion is the textbook one, and a faithful Lean
definition is one that (together with the other definitions) yields the textbook object on the
paper's basis for every integrand the paper's claims use; junk values outside that class are
harmless only if every proposition restricts to the class.

comparison.text:
Comparison: def:LevyStochCalc.Brownian.Multidim.MultidimBrownianMotion.naturalFiltration (MultidimFiltered.lean:79-82)

Reading: the JOINT natural filtration sigma(W^j_s : s <= t, j < d), raw.
Lean: naturalFiltration W := iSup over i of Martingale.naturalFiltration (W.W i). The supremum of
filtrations in Mathlib is pointwise (Filtration.sSup_def: seq t := sSup of the t-th
sigma-algebras), so at time t it is sup_i sup_{s <= t} comap(W^i_s) = sigma(W^i_s : s <= t, all
i): the joint natural filtration, not that of one coordinate. Raw (augmentation and enlargement
are added by consumers: enlJoint via LevyDriver.filtration, enlBrownian in sec. 5). Negative
times as in Martingale.naturalFiltration (a.s. trivial generators), harmless. d = 0 gives the
trivial filtration, consistent. Matches the reading.
Verdict: faithful.

author_review.disagreements:
No disagreement on substance; labelling. The reviewer records "faithful with representation
choices" (R-indexed time, with the a.s.-trivial negative-time generators; supremum of the d
one-dimensional natural filtrations). I recorded "faithful" here but "faithful with
representation choices" for Martingale.naturalFiltration for the same negative-time point, so the
reviewer's label is the consistent one and I accept it.
